GENERATE BURST T2K-idle-r2 — (third attempt: attempt 1 lost the plate in every generation; its salvage showed faces painted onto heads turned away) Run C-9 pipeline test T2 (Matt R-C9-62): PAINT-OVER of the 3D manticore, idle, key frames in six directions, on one sheet. task_id "T2K-idle-r2".

IMAGE 1 is a SHEET of 12 KEY FRAMES of ONE IDLE LOOP (standing, breathing, a slow head turn, the tail swaying) of a four-legged creature, a 4x3 grid on flat pure #00ff00, each frame centred in its own cell, seen from different directions in reading order: row 1: facing the viewer (south), facing the viewer (south), facing away to the upper-right (north-east), facing away to the upper-right (north-east); row 2: seen from behind (north), seen from behind (north), facing away to the upper-left (north-west), facing away to the upper-left (north-west); row 3: facing the viewer's left (west), facing the viewer's left (west), facing the lower-left (south-west), facing the lower-left (south-west).
The frames are renders of a 3D model: their POSES, OUTLINES, POSITIONS and SIZES are correct, but their surface is flat and plastic.
IMAGE 2 is the APPROVED character sheet of this creature, the MANTICORE (four views: top-left front, top-right its right side facing the viewer's right, bottom-left back, bottom-right its left side facing the viewer's left): its lean hound body with ribs showing, blue-grey hide with a darker spine and paler belly, clawed paws, the long whip tail, and the calm bearded, long-haired face of a MAN with a mane around it; and the painter's hand (dark ink line, hatching, transparent washes). IMAGE 3 is the 13th-century bestiary page it comes from: the face and the uncanny calm to keep.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet in which EVERY figure is repainted as the manticore of IMAGE 2 seen from that cell's direction, in EXACTLY that frame's pose, outline, position and size: same place in its cell, same leg, tail and head angles, paws on the same spots. Paint every frame as ONE consistent creature in ONE consistent hand: the same hide, markings, mane, face and colours in every frame (this is an animation: any change between frames will flicker). The face stays the calm bearded man's face of IMAGE 2 and IMAGE 3 in every frame.
Keep the background flat pure #00ff00 and the 4x3 grid exactly as laid out: no frame added, removed, merged or reordered, no cell borders, no text, no ground shadows.

BACKGROUND: keep the background flat pure #00ff00, as in IMAGE 1. If the image model returns a darker or gradient background anyway, DO NOT spend a retry on it and still deliver the image: the figures are cut out afterwards by their exact 3D outlines, so the background colour does not decide success. Spend retries ONLY on pose, facing, identity, frame-count or grid faults.

HEAD ORIENTATION (the most important correction; a previous attempt got this wrong in every sheet): paint skin ONLY where IMAGE 1 shows the face. In the cells seen from behind (north), the creature's head faces AWAY from the viewer: paint the BACK of the head — the long hair falling over the back of the skull, the mane around the neck — with NO face, NO eyes, NO nose and NO mouth visible. In the cells facing away to the upper-right (north-east) and upper-left (north-west), the head is turned mostly away: the back and side of the hair and mane, with at most the edge of a cheek and beard at the side, exactly as far as IMAGE 1 shows it — no eye, no nose. Only the cells facing the viewer (south), the lower-left (south-west) and the left (west) show the face.
STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 2: copy its hand; do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if a frame's pose, facing or position changed, a frame is missing or duplicated,  the creature differs between frames, a face is painted on a head that IMAGE 1 shows turned away — name the reason. Never retry for the background colour. Copy outputs to out/T2K-idle-r2_a.png and out/T2K-idle-r2_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "T2K-idle-r2"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the sheet to EDIT (12 idle frames of the Meshy 3D manticore; poses correct, surface flat)
IMAGE 2 — the approved four-view character sheet of the manticore (look, markings, face, hand)
IMAGE 3 — the bestiary source (Rochester Bestiary, c.1230, public domain): the face and its calm
